title: Challange Timer Core
description: Adds an Customizable Timer to your Minecraft Server.
body:
# Challange Timer Core
## Commands
| Command             | Aliases                    | Permission          |
|---------------------|----------------------------|---------------------|
| /timer              | /t                         | `timer.manage`      |

## Subcommands
> `/timer`: Shows the current time on the Timer
> 
> `/timer resume`: Continues the Timer
> 
> `/timer pause`: Pauses the Timer
> 
> `/timer reset`: Resets the Timer
> 
> `/timer time set <Seconds>`: Sets the Timer time
> 
> `/timer time add <Seconds>`: Adds time to the Timer
> 
> `/timer time remove <Seconds>`: Removes time to the Timer

## Support 
If you need Support with the Configuration or hav found an Bug, please contact us via our linked Discord Server. Thanks for using our plugin :D

## Configuration
The `config.yml` will always start with the `ChallangeCore`. In other parts, you can configure all Messages.
